flags.message: The application pairs its stay request with a request for a temporary administrative stay. If the Circuit Justice enters a short administrative stay before denying the application, the docket will carry a grant-shaped interim entry followed by the denial; the forecast prices the terminal disposition (P(unqualified grant) = 0.04), so if the interim resolver latches the administrative entry instead, the cell resolves against a different question than the one predicted. Worth a glance at the resolved entry text when this event closes.
